# Tutorials

This chapter provides step-by-step tutorials on using `r pkg("hespresso")`
with real RNA-seq datasets. The workflows cover data preparation through
statistical testing with HOBIT and demonstrate practical approaches for
detecting shifts in homeolog expression ratios across different conditions.
